simple.meaning: עָנַק (ʻânaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to collar , i.e. adorn with a necklace ; figuratively, to fit out with supplies.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Deuteronomy, Psalms, beginning at Deuteronomy 15:14. Its contexts include flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָנַק (H6059).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
